About OrgVia

People at the center. Everything in its place.

OrgVia is a multi-tenant HRMS platform designed around the operational work that sits behind a healthy, organized team.

Why a shared workspace matters

Employee information, time and leave activity, and the processes around pay or performance often live in too many places. The result is not just more administration—it is less confidence in the information people use to make decisions.

OrgVia is intended to give organizations a more coherent home for those workflows while retaining the boundaries and access controls needed in a multi-organization platform.

What we can say with confidence

  • OrgVia brings core HRMS workflows together in one product.
  • It supports organization-specific administration in a multi-tenant architecture.
  • Its product areas include employee management, attendance, leave, payroll workflows, recruitment, onboarding and performance management.
